nkd90399.note: Titles below align with NKD 90399 event/arts support. Employer still verifies whether any title appears on the current HZZ/MUP deficitary (UV) list before assuming an LMT exemption.

occupations.uvListReminder: Use the UV search panel (official LMT-exemption PDF) and re-check the live HZZ hub before skipping the labor market test. Art. 110 police categories are a separate channel.

manualEventCrew.title: Manual event crew / physical labor
manualEventCrew.blurb: Load-in/load-out, carrying equipment, physical stage support. Primary intent for this case; expect labor market test unless listed as deficitary.

stageHand.title: Stage hand / scenotehničar (support)
stageHand.blurb: Hands-on stage and set support under arts/event activity. Often more recognizable to HZZ than a vague “worker” title.

eventSetup.title: Event setup / strike worker
eventSetup.blurb: Temporary structure, seating, and gear setup for shows and events. Document concrete duties tied to registered activity.

venueSupport.title: Venue / production support worker
venueSupport.blurb: On-site physical support for venues and productions. Keep the job description free of unrelated office tasks.

manualEventCrew.intro: Starter duty bullets for manual event crew under arts/event support. Adapt to the real venue and remove anything you will not do.
manualEventCrew.b1: Load-in and load-out of event equipment, cases, and staging materials at the venue.
manualEventCrew.b2: Carry, place, and strike physical production gear under direction of the production lead.
manualEventCrew.b3: Assist with temporary floor protection, cable runs on the floor, and clear egress paths during setup/strike.
manualEventCrew.b4: Support physical stage / set moves between cues as instructed (no unrelated office or IT work).
manualEventCrew.b5: Follow on-site safety instructions for manual handling during rehearsals, shows, and wrap.

stageHand.intro: Starter duty bullets for stage-hand / scenotehničar support. Keep wording tied to performing-arts support.
stageHand.b1: Assist with assembly, placement, and strike of stage decks, soft goods, and scenic elements.
stageHand.b2: Move and secure stage props and set pieces under the stage manager / technical lead.
stageHand.b3: Support scene changes and physical resets during rehearsals and performances.
stageHand.b4: Help maintain clear wing and backstage pathways for safe movement of people and scenery.
stageHand.b5: Perform other physical stage-support tasks assigned within the registered arts/event activity.

eventSetup.intro: Starter duty bullets for event setup / strike. Document only work you will actually perform.
eventSetup.b1: Set and strike temporary seating, barriers, and non-structural event layouts.
eventSetup.b2: Assemble and dismantle portable event furniture and display elements.
eventSetup.b3: Position and remove event gear according to the site plan.
eventSetup.b4: Clean work areas after setup/strike as part of the physical event-support role.

venueSupport.intro: Starter duty bullets for venue / production support. Avoid mixing in unrelated hospitality or desk work.
venueSupport.b1: Provide on-site physical support for venue and production operations during events.
venueSupport.b2: Move production supplies and equipment between storage and performance areas.
venueSupport.b3: Assist technical leads with physical preparations before doors and after curtain.
venueSupport.b4: Support safe clearing of production areas after the event.

orient.title: Orient & eligibility
orient.summary: Confirm the Single Permit + LMT path and that this employer can hire under Art. 99-style conditions.

overview.title: What you are applying for
overview.body: For most third-country nationals taking employed work in Croatia, the standard route is a combined stay-and-work authorization (Single Permit) issued by MUP. Employment usually requires a prior HZZ labor market test unless the occupation is on the HZZ Upravno vijeće (UV) deficitary list (LMT skip, online filing) or another separate Art. 110 category applies (police filing — key personnel, Blue Card, ICT, etc.). This wizard follows the LMT → Single Permit path for manual event crew work.

path.title: Primary path for this case
path.body: Confirm employer eligibility with the Art. 99 guided check → search the UV list for any NKD-plausible LMT skip → lock an NKD-aligned occupation title → prepare the employer package → run the HZZ labor market test (default) → collect worker documents → file the stay-and-work application → biometrics / registrations → stay compliant. Do not treat short visa-free entry as work authorization.

employerThresholds.title: Employer eligibility thresholds
employerThresholds.body: Use the guided Art. 99 self-check below for where and how to verify each condition. Cited numeric thresholds:

wrongPaths.title: Wrong paths for this job
wrongPaths.body: EU Blue Card is for highly qualified roles meeting salary/qualification thresholds — not physical event crew (do not use Blue Card fees or validity rules for this hire). Seasonal-tourism shortcuts only apply when the occupation and sector truly fit. Student permits are a different regime.

law2026.title: 2026 law note (NN 55/2026)
law2026.body: Amendments include Single Permit framing, longer decision planning windows, worker mobility rules, unemployment windows, Form 17a / housing standards, and A1.1 Croatian + Latin script rules for extensions (some language provisions are deferred — see Compliance facts). General in-force date:

check.readOverview: I understand Single Permit + LMT is the intended path
check.art99: I completed the guided Art. 99 self-check (all rows below)
check.lmtPath: I used the UV search panel and am not assuming an LMT skip without a listed title
check.excludeBlueCard: I confirmed Blue Card / seasonal shortcuts do not fit this role
check.verifyRevenue: I will verify inflow threshold standing with live evidence

occupation.title: Pick the occupation
occupation.summary: Choose a defensible title tied to NKD 90399; decide LMT vs possible deficitary exemption.

overview.title: How to lock the title
overview.body: Select a suggested occupation for this employer’s NKD, search the official UV LMT-exemption list without title-shopping, decide LMT vs a true UV match, then adapt the duty template. Use the same title and duties on the contract, LMT request, and Single Permit.

check.guided: I completed the guided occupation self-check (all rows below)

employerPackage.title: Prepare employer package
employerPackage.summary: Contract, pay parity, Form 17a / housing, and tax readiness before HZZ/MUP filing.

overview.title: What to assemble
overview.body: Before HZZ or MUP filing, assemble the employer-side package: Croatian-law contract or binding offer, pay-parity rationale, current Form 17a (verify the live template — field specs are not invented here), housing evidence path, and tax/contribution standing. Use the guided checklist below.

check.guided: I completed the guided employer-package self-check (all rows below)

lmt.title: Run HZZ labor market test
lmt.summary: Submit the test tržišta rada, keep related-activity consistency, use the positive-notice window.

overview.title: What this step covers
overview.body: The labor market test (test tržišta rada) lets HZZ assess whether the vacancy can be filled from the domestic/EEA register. Follow the guided filing workflow below using HZZ’s published hubs — do not invent a private portal URL.

check.guided: I completed the guided LMT filing self-check (all rows below)

workerDocs.title: Collect worker documents
workerDocs.summary: Assemble the worker’s file for the stay-and-work application. Country-specific steps (for example U.S. FBI checks) appear in the nationality panel.

overview.title: What belongs in the worker file
overview.body: Use the guided checklist below for the common documents every third-country national usually needs. Then complete the nationality panel for country-specific steps. Always re-check the live MUP temporary-stay page for the exact list that applies to your filing.

check.guided: I completed the guided worker-document self-check (all rows below)

filePermit.title: File stay-and-work (Single Permit)
filePermit.summary: File in-country at the competent Zagreb police/MUP desk after LMT (unless exempt). Use Form 2a and cited fees.

overview.title: Zagreb filing overview
overview.body: For this Zagreb-seat case, file the stay-and-work application in-country once the labor market precondition is met and employer + worker documents are ready. Confirm the exact PU Zagrebačka receiving desk on MUP pages. Use the guided checklist below. Consular-channel notes (if any) stay in the nationality panel. Biometrics attendance is the next step.

check.guided: Filing guided checks complete (Form 2a, Zagreb desk, fees, submit, proof)

startWork.title: Decision, biometrics, start work
startWork.summary: After filing: wait for the decision, biometrics and card, then HZMO / HZZO / tax — start work only when authorized.

overview.title: After the application is filed
overview.body: Do not put the worker on productive paid work in Croatia until stay-and-work authorization is in place. Use the guided checklist for decision → fees on approval → biometrics → card → address registration → social/tax registrations → authorized start. Visa-free presence is not a substitute.

check.guided: Start-work guided checks complete (decision through authorized start)

comply.title: Stay compliant
comply.summary: Track dates, employer-change and unemployment windows, A1.1 language plan, renewals.

overview.title: Compliance calendar
overview.body: After work starts, keep a shared calendar for card expiry, employer-change rules, unemployment windows, and the A1.1 language obligation (partly deferred). Re-open NN 55/2026 and MUP pages before relying on any window. Long-term residence is a later pathway.

check.guided: Compliance guided checks complete (dates through long-term awareness)

guided.passLabel: I completed this check with current evidence

art99.panelIntro: Work through each condition in order. Mark a row only after you have pulled the evidence. Completing every row marks the Step 1 Art. 99 checklist item.
art99.passLabel: I completed this check with current evidence

activity.title: Registered activity matches the intended occupation
activity.why: HZZ expects the requested occupation to relate to the employer’s registered economic activity in Croatia.

how.fina: Open the company on Fina Info.BIZ and confirm status, address, and NKD / activity wording.
how.court: Optionally confirm the court-register extract (Sudski registar) for legal form and representation.
how.match: Write the intended job duties and confirm they sit inside the registered arts/event-support activity — not an unrelated desk, IT, or hospitality role.

activity.evidence: Current company extract / Info.BIZ printout + draft duty list mapped to NKD.
activity.caseHint: Example NKD 90399 (legacy 9002): other support activities to artistic creation and performing arts. Stage/event physical support fits; unrelated titles do not.

continuous.title: Continuous domestic / EEA / Swiss full-time employee
continuous.why: A positive HZZ opinion generally requires continuous employment of at least one HR/EEA/Swiss worker on indefinite full-time terms for the cited lookback.

how.hzmo: Review employer contribution / insured-person records via HZMO employer channels.
how.payroll: Pull payroll / employment contracts showing the same domestic/EEA/Swiss worker on full-time indefinite terms.
how.continuity: Confirm there is no gap that breaks continuous employment across the cited lookback.

continuous.evidence: Payroll/HZMO evidence naming the continuous domestic/EEA/Swiss FTE and dates.
continuous.caseHint: Micro employers with ~one employee must still verify that person is HR/EEA/Swiss, full-time, indefinite, and continuous for the lookback — micro size does not waive this.

ratio.title: Domestic : third-country national workforce ratio
ratio.why: At filing, full-time domestic/EEA/Swiss headcount must meet the cited minimum share of third-country national headcount (HZZ also counts prior positive opinions in the ratio mechanics).

how.count: Count current full-time HR/EEA/Swiss employees and current third-country national employees (plus any HZZ positive opinions that count toward the foreign side per HZZ rules).
how.compare: Compare domestic full-time headcount to the foreign side using the general ratio fact below.
how.uvNote: If you later hire on a UV deficitary occupation title, the lower deficitary ratio fact applies instead — still verify live HZZ wording.

ratio.evidence: Headcount worksheet with names/status + calculation against the cited percentage.
ratio.caseHint: With ~one domestic employee, hiring even one TCN can fail the general ratio unless the numbers truly work. Model the hire before filing.

tax.title: No unpaid public dues (tax / contributions)
tax.why: Employers must have settled public dues recorded by the finance ministry and filed required tax reports.

how.eporezna: Check tax standing in ePorezna (Porezna uprava) for the company OIB.
how.hzmo: Confirm contribution standing with HZMO / related contribution channels.
how.certificate: Obtain a current certificate / extract showing no unpaid dues before HZZ/MUP filing.

tax.evidence: Recent official certificate or portal extract showing clear dues status.

inflow.title: Transaction-account inflow threshold (legal entity)
inflow.why: Legal-entity employers must show the cited minimum inflow on the transaction account over the lookback HZZ applies.

how.bank: Request bank statements / turnover confirmation for the company transaction account(s).
how.window: Sum inflows for the period HZZ requires and compare to the cited legal-entity threshold.
how.notFina: Do not treat Fina published annual revenue alone as proof of transaction-account inflow.

inflow.evidence: Bank inflow evidence covering the required period, totaling at least the cited threshold.
inflow.caseHint: Published company revenue (if any) is not bank inflow proof. Pull live bank evidence before filing.

blocked.title: No prolonged blocked account
blocked.why: A continuous blockade longer than the cited maximum in the relevant lookback can block a positive opinion.

how.bank: Ask the bank whether the account was blocked and for how many continuous days.
how.fina: Check FINA / enforcement blockade information channels available to the company.
how.window: Confirm no continuous blockade exceeded the cited day maximum in the applicable lookback.

blocked.evidence: Bank/FINA confirmation of blockade history (or none) for the lookback.

criminal.title: No disqualifying labour / social-security convictions or serious misdemeanours
criminal.why: HZZ checks whether the employer has final convictions or the most serious labour / social-security / OSH misdemeanour sanctions that bar a positive opinion.

how.review: Review company and responsible-person history for labour-relation, social-security, and OSH matters.
how.counsel: If unsure, obtain counsel or official extracts before filing rather than guessing.

criminal.evidence: Internal clearance note and any official extracts counsel recommends.

undeclared.title: Not listed for undeclared work
undeclared.why: Employers on the undeclared-work list under the special anti-undeclared-work rules are barred from a positive opinion.

how.hzz: Confirm via HZZ guidance / filing process that the employer is not treated as listed for undeclared work.
how.inspectorate: If status is unclear, ask the labour inspectorate / competent ministry channel before filing.

undeclared.evidence: Written confirmation or filing-system clear status that the employer is not on the prohibited list.

pkg.panelIntro: Assemble the employer-side file before HZZ/MUP. Mark a row only after you have the evidence. Completing every row marks the Step 3 checklist item.

contract.title: Employment contract / binding offer terms
contract.why: HZZ and MUP filings need a clear Croatian-law contract or binding offer: position, place of work, hours, and pay aligned with the occupation you will request.

how.draft: Draft the contract or binding offer with role title, workplace, working time, and remuneration.
how.mup: Cross-check stay-and-work document expectations on the MUP third-country national work page.
how.hzzTips: Align wording with HZZ filing tips so title, duties, and workplace stay consistent across later LMT and permit filings.

contract.evidence: Signed or ready-to-sign contract / binding offer PDF plus company extract (OIB, representation).
contract.caseHint: Keep the occupation title consistent with NKD {nkd} ({nkdLabel}) and the duties you will put on the LMT request.

payParity.title: Pay meets minimums and parity expectations
payParity.why: Remuneration should meet applicable Croatian minimums and be comparable to domestic workers in similar roles — do not invent a euro figure in this wizard.

how.compare: Compare the offered pay to how you pay (or would pay) a domestic worker for the same duties and hours.
how.official: Confirm current legal minimum / stay-and-work pay expectations on official MUP / labour channels before filing.
how.noInvent: Do not copy unofficial salary blogs into the file — use primary law or competent authority guidance.

payParity.evidence: Pay table or offer letter showing amount + note of the official source you used for the minimum/parity check.

form17a.title: Confirm current Form 17a (no invented field list)
form17a.why: NN 55/2026 introduced Form 17a (employer compliance/liability). This runbook does not invent form fields — you must pull the live official template.

how.nn: Read the Form 17a / employer-obligation context in NN 55/2026.
how.mup: Check MUP third-country national work pages for the current employer declaration / Form 17a channel.
how.verifyCurrent: Download or obtain the current official Form 17a template from those channels — omit any field list that is not on the live form.

form17a.evidence: Current official Form 17a (blank or completed draft) with retrieval date noted.
form17a.caseHint: Intentional omission: this wizard does not ship Form 17a field specifications.

housing.title: Housing evidence path
housing.why: NN 55/2026 clarified standards when the employer provides accommodation; if the worker arranges housing, the permit file still needs proof of accommodation.

how.path: Decide employer-provided vs worker-arranged housing before filing.
how.nn: Review housing-related standards in NN 55/2026 / MUP guidance — do not invent square-metre thresholds here.
how.document: Collect lease, employer housing agreement, or other accommodation proof that matches the chosen path.

housing.evidence: Lease / employer housing agreement / accommodation confirmation matching the chosen path.

tax.title: Tax and contribution standing; blocked account
tax.why: Unpaid tax/contribution debts and prolonged blocked accounts undermine Art. 99-style eligibility and later filings.

how.eporezna: Check tax standing in ePorezna / Tax Administration channels.
how.hzmo: Check contribution standing via HZMO channels.
how.certificate: Obtain current clearance evidence and confirm the account is not blocked beyond the cited window.

tax.evidence: Tax/contribution clearance printouts + bank status note dated close to filing.

handoff.title: Art. 99 inflow / eligibility evidence ready
handoff.why: Step 1 guided Art. 99 checks (especially bank inflow and blocked-account) must be finished before HZZ treats the employer package as filing-ready. Published company revenue is not bank-inflow proof.

how.orient: Confirm every Orient Art. 99 guided row is complete with current evidence.
how.bank: Pull live bank statements covering the inflow lookback — do not rely on FINA revenue alone.
how.hzz: Re-read HZZ novi sustav eligibility thresholds before submitting LMT.

handoff.evidence: Completed Art. 99 evidence pack (bank inflow, continuous employment, ratio model) ready to attach or show on request.
handoff.caseHint: Case revenue on the employer card is not Art. 99 inflow proof — use bank evidence for NKD {nkd} employer before filing.

lmtGuide.panelTitle: HZZ labor market test — guided filing
lmtGuide.panelIntro: Work the LMT path in order. Use only HZZ’s published hubs for procedure. Completing every row marks the Step 4 checklist item.

confirmPath.title: Confirm LMT is still the correct path
confirmPath.why: UV / deficitary list skips apply only when the exact listed title and real duties match. Manual event crew under arts-support NKD usually stays on LMT.

how.uv: Re-check the official UV / radne dozvole materials if you thought an exemption applied.
how.noShopping: Do not pick a UV title that mismatches real duties just to skip LMT.
how.hzz: Confirm on HZZ novi sustav that your hire still needs the labor market test.

confirmPath.evidence: Short note: LMT required (or exact UV title + duties match with PDF edition cited).
confirmPath.caseHint: For NKD {nkd} manual event crew, treat LMT as primary unless a listed UV title truly matches duties.

related.title: Occupation related to registered activity
related.why: HZZ expects the requested occupation to relate to the employer’s registered economic activity.

how.fina: Confirm registered activity / NKD on Fina Info.BIZ.
how.duties: Write duties that sit inside that activity — not an unrelated desk, IT, or hospitality role.
how.tips: Use HZZ filing tips to keep title, workplace, and activity wording consistent.

related.evidence: Company extract + duty list mapped to registered activity.
related.caseHint: Registered activity for this case: NKD {nkd} — {nkdLabel}.

assemble.title: Assemble the LMT request package
assemble.why: Incomplete or inconsistent attachments are a common reason for delay or refusal.

how.contents: Assemble occupation title, duties, workplace, employer identity docs, and required attachments per HZZ guidance.
how.tips: Walk HZZ Savjeti za predaju zahtjeva as the operational checklist.
how.consistency: Ensure the same title/duties/workplace appear on contract, LMT request, and later Single Permit forms.

assemble.evidence: Complete LMT request folder (PDF/scans) ready to submit.

submit.title: Submit via current HZZ published procedure
submit.why: Procedure and channels change; this runbook does not invent a private e-portal URL beyond HZZ’s published pages.

how.hub: Open HZZ novi sustav zapošljavanja stranaca for the current legal/process overview.
how.tips: Follow Savjeti za predaju zahtjeva for practical submission steps.
how.current: Use whatever submission channel those pages currently prescribe (do not rely on outdated third-party portal links).

submit.evidence: Submission receipt / protocol number / confirmation email from HZZ.
submit.caseHint: Route the request for competence tied to region {region} (confirm on HZZ pages if regional routing applies).

notice.title: Handle positive or negative notice
notice.why: The notice outcome drives whether you may file the Single Permit and whether you must revise the occupation path.

how.store: Save the full HZZ notice PDF and note the issue date.
how.positive: If positive, immediately start the Single Permit clock (next check).
how.negative: If negative/refused, revise occupation/duties or reassess exemptions before refiling — do not ignore the grounds.

notice.evidence: Stored HZZ notice + short decision note (proceed / revise).

window.title: Calendar the Single Permit filing window
window.why: A positive labor-market opinion is time-limited. Missing the window means repeating LMT work.

how.calendar: Put the notice issue date and deadline on a shared calendar with owner + reminder.
how.hzz: Confirm the validity window on HZZ novi sustav (cited fact below).
how.mup: Prepare the stay-and-work / Single Permit filing path on MUP radne dozvole materials in parallel.

window.evidence: Calendar entry + owner named; notice PDF linked.

competence.title: Confirm regional / competence routing
competence.why: Employer seat and workplace affect which HZZ / police administration handles later steps; confirm before you file.

how.case: Read the loaded case employer city / HZZ region / police administration fields.
how.hzz: Confirm any regional routing notes on HZZ published pages.
how.confirm: Write down which office you will use for LMT follow-up and for the later Single Permit filing.

competence.evidence: One-line competence note (HZZ unit + intended police administration).
competence.caseHint: This case region: {region}. Employer card shows the live address — do not hardcode another city.

occGuide.panelIntro: Lock one filing title, search the UV list honestly, adapt duty bullets, and record whether LMT remains required. Completing every row marks the Step 2 checklist item.

pick.title: Select the filing occupation title
pick.why: HZZ and MUP need one concrete title that matches real duties — vague “worker” labels invite questions.

how.list: Review the NKD-aligned suggestions for this employer.
how.select: Click Select for filing on the title you will use on the contract and HZZ request.
how.consistent: Do not plan to change the title later without updating contract, LMT, and permit forms together.

pick.evidence: Selected title noted in this wizard + draft contract heading with the same wording.
pick.caseHint: Suggestions are filtered for employer NKD {nkd} ({nkdLabel}).

nkd.title: Confirm title fits registered activity
nkd.why: Requested occupation must relate to the employer’s registered economic activity.

how.card: Read the employer card NKD / activity label for this case.
how.fina: Confirm the live company extract on Fina Info.BIZ if needed.
how.duties: Ensure duty bullets describe work inside that activity — not unrelated desk, IT, or hospitality tasks.

nkd.evidence: Duty list mapped to NKD wording from the company extract.

uv.title: Search the official UV LMT-exemption list
uv.why: LMT skip applies only for exact titles on the official UV PDF that match real duties and region — not for invented stagehand labels.

how.panel: Use the UV search panel on this step (default filter: this region + NKD-relevant tags).
how.pdf: Open the official MUP-hosted UV PDF when you need the source text.
how.hub: Re-open the live MUP/HZZ radne dozvole hub before filing — the list can be amended.
how.noShopping: If nothing matches duties, keep LMT. Optionally mark a UV row as a candidate only for honest review.

uv.evidence: Screenshot or note of UV search + either “no match → LMT” or exact listed title with edition.
uv.caseHint: Region filter: {region}. Manual event crew under NKD {nkd} usually stays on LMT.

path.title: Record LMT vs UV-skip decision
path.why: The next steps (employer package and HZZ filing) depend on whether you truly have a UV match.

how.lmtDefault: Default: choose Labor market test unless an exact UV title matches duties.
how.uvOnly: Choose UV candidate only if the official listed title and real duties match — then re-verify live before filing.
how.record: Set the path decision control under the duty template and keep it consistent with Step 4.

path.evidence: Path decision saved in this wizard (LMT or named UV candidate).
path.caseHint: When unsure, keep LMT — false UV skips are a rejection risk.

duties.title: Adapt the duty template
duties.why: HZZ filing tips expect clear, consistent duties tied to the occupation and registered activity.

how.template: Open the duty template for the selected occupation on this step.
how.adapt: Edit the bullets offline to match real work; delete tasks you will not perform.
how.hzz: Keep wording aligned with HZZ Savjeti za predaju zahtjeva consistency guidance.

duties.evidence: Final duty bullet list ready to paste into contract / LMT / permit forms.
duties.caseHint: Templates are starters for NKD {nkd} event/arts support — not official HZZ forms.

lock.title: Lock the same title across filings
lock.why: Mismatched titles between contract, LMT, and Single Permit create refusal risk.

how.contract: Use the selected title on the employment contract / binding offer.
how.lmt: Use the same title and duties on the HZZ labor market test request.
how.permit: Carry the same wording into the MUP stay-and-work / Single Permit file.

lock.evidence: One-line lock note: title string + date + where it appears (contract / LMT / permit).

uv.panelIntro: Search occupations from the official HZZ/MUP PDF of titles for which the employer is not required to run a {lmt}. Default filter: titles tagged as plausibly relevant to this company’s NKD, and valid in Grad Zagreb (or nationwide).
uv.art110Note: Separate channel: Art. 110 categories (key personnel, Blue Card, ICT transfer, etc.) file at the police — they are not this searchable {uv} table.
uv.listStaleBanner: This tool ships the official 2023 PDF still hosted by MUP/HZZ. Re-open the live HZZ “Lista zanimanja…” hub before filing — the list can be amended after this edition.
uv.toggleAllZagreb: Show all {uv} titles valid in Grad Zagreb (not only NKD-relevant)
uv.regionAll: Valid in all counties (nationwide on this list)
uv.regionLimited: Regional title — includes Grad Zagreb on this list edition
uv.emptyState: No {uv} titles match this filter. For manual event crew under NKD 90399, treat the {lmt} as the primary path — do not invent a title that is not on the official list or that mismatches real duties.
uv.noTitleShopping: Skipping the {lmt} applies only if the exact occupation title and real duties match a listed {uv} title and your registered activity. Title shopping that mismatches actual work is a rejection risk.

seasonal.sales: Seasonal sales title on the official list — only for the work period stated on the PDF and only in listed counties (not Grad Zagreb on this edition).

relevance.crane: Possibly relevant to event/venue load-in if the worker truly operates a crane under your registered activity — document duties carefully.
relevance.joiner: Woodwork / stage carpentry can support performing-arts productions when duties match.
relevance.electrical: Electrical install/fit work can support stage and venue power when duties and qualifications match.
relevance.metalStructure: Metal structure fitting can support stage/set structures when duties match event/arts support.
relevance.sheetMetal: Sheet-metal work is only relevant if the real job is metal fabrication for productions — not generic event crew.
relevance.locksmith: Metalworker/locksmith duties must match actual production metalwork, not a label of convenience.
relevance.steelRope: Steel-rope / lift-cable fitting may relate to venue lift or flying systems — only if that is the real job.
relevance.cleaner: Cleaner appears on the UV list for Grad Zagreb. Use only if the hire is genuinely cleaning work tied to your activity — not a substitute label for stagehand.

offices.bookNote: This address book lists agencies that appear in the runbook. Prefer the official website links for current phone numbers, e-services, and counters. We do not invent unpublished phone numbers.
offices.verifyOnSite: Verify opening hours and contact details on the official site before you act.

hzz.name: Croatian Employment Service (HZZ)
hzz.role: Runs the labor market test and publishes employer rules for hiring foreign workers.
hzz.hubLabel: HZZ — foreign workers / labor market test
hzz.addressNote: Use the Zagreb regional office for local employer contact. Central HQ is Radnička cesta 1; published online hubs remain the filing source of truth.

mup.name: Ministry of the Interior (MUP)
mup.role: Issues stay-and-work decisions and publishes rules for third-country nationals.

puZagreb.name: Police administration (Zagreb area)
puZagreb.role: Competent police administration for Grad Zagreb stay-and-work follow-up, foreigner status desks, and biometric card logistics.
puZagreb.hubLabel: PU zagrebačka — how and where to file
puZagreb.addressNote: For this Grad Zagreb seat/workplace case, foreigner-status work is at Remetinečki gaj 13. Biometric card production/pickup for foreign nationals is at Petrinjska 30. Re-check the PU zagrebačka “how and where” page before you go — channels change.
puZagreb.emailNote: zg.drzavljanstvo.stranci@mup.hr is published for certain foreigner-status e-mail filings. The separate radna.dozvola.zagreb@mup.hr channel is for non–labor-market-test / Art. 110 / extension paths only — not a first filing that still needs the labor market test.

fina.name: Fina (company register / Info.BIZ)
fina.role: Public company data used to confirm activity, address, and identifiers.

porezna.name: Tax Administration (Porezna uprava)
porezna.role: Tax standing and ePorezna services used in employer eligibility checks.

hzmo.name: Croatian Pension Insurance Institute (HZMO)
hzmo.role: Pension contributions and employment continuity evidence.

hzzo.name: Croatian Health Insurance Fund (HZZO)
hzzo.role: Health insurance registration after authorized work starts.

mvep.name: Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs (MVEP)
mvep.role: Consular stay guidance (entry, short stay, registration timing).

usEmbassy.name: U.S. Embassy Zagreb
usEmbassy.role: U.S.-citizen practical guidance (entry/residence notes, FBI background-check pointers). Does not replace Croatian MUP/HZZ rules.

offices.zagrebScope: Scope note: desks and competence below are modeled for a Grad Zagreb employer/workplace (this case: Savska cesta area). Other police administrations are not mapped yet — confirm the competent desk on official pages before you visit or file.

singlePermit.title: Stay-and-work permit (Single Permit)
singlePermit.body: One decision that covers both living and working in Croatia for a third-country national employee. It is usually issued after a positive labor market test (unless an official exemption applies).

lmt.title: Labor market test (test tržišta rada)
lmt.body: A check run by the Croatian Employment Service (HZZ). It asks whether the job could be filled by a worker already available on the domestic/EEA market before a third-country national is hired.

hzz.title: HZZ — Croatian Employment Service
hzz.body: The public employment service. For this runbook, HZZ is where employers file the labor market test and find employer eligibility rules.

mup.title: MUP — Ministry of the Interior
mup.body: The ministry that handles stay-and-work applications and many residence rules for foreigners.

art99.title: Article 99 employer conditions
art99.body: Legal employer conditions (workforce ratio, continuous domestic employment, tax/contribution standing, blocked accounts, and related checks) that HZZ expects before a positive opinion. This runbook turns them into a guided checklist.

uvList.title: Upravno vijeće deficitary occupations list (exemption from the labor market test)
uvList.body: An official list of occupation titles for which the employer may skip the labor market test. Only exact listed titles that match real duties count — do not invent a title to skip the test.

nkd.title: NKD — activity classification code
nkd.body: The company’s registered economic activity code. The job you request should fit that activity (for example arts/event support codes for physical event crew).

tcn.title: Third-country national
tcn.body: A person who is not a citizen of Croatia, another EU/EEA country, or Switzerland. U.S. citizens are third-country nationals for Croatian work-permit rules.

form17a.title: Form 17a
form17a.body: An employer compliance/liability form introduced in the 2026 foreigners-law updates. Always download the current official template — this runbook does not invent form fields.

oib.title: OIB — personal/company tax ID
oib.body: The Croatian identification number used on company and personal filings. Employers and workers both need the correct OIB on applications.

hzmo.title: HZMO — pension insurance institute
hzmo.body: Handles pension insurance. Employers use it for contribution standing and proof that domestic staff are employed continuously.

hzzo.title: HZZO — health insurance fund
hzzo.body: Handles public health insurance registration once work is authorized.

mvep.title: MVEP — foreign affairs ministry
mvep.body: Publishes consular information about stay and entry (including short-stay and registration timing).

nn.title: Narodne novine (Official Gazette)
nn.body: Where Croatian laws are officially published. Amendments such as NN 55/2026 update the Aliens Act (Zakon o strancima).

blueCard.title: EU Blue Card
blueCard.body: A separate path for highly qualified workers with salary/qualification thresholds. Manual event crew / physical labor is not a Blue Card hire.

a1.title: A1.1 Croatian language requirement
a1.body: A language level (A1.1, Latin script) that can be required for extending stay under 2026 rules. Some related articles have a deferred force date — see the Compliance step facts.

form2a.title: Form 2a (Obrazac 2a)
form2a.body: The official application form for a stay-and-work permit. Always download the current template from MUP Obrasci — this runbook does not invent form fields. Form 17a is a separate employer form.

wdGuide.panelIntro: Gather evidence the worker will need for the stay-and-work filing. Mark a row only when you have the document or a clear order in progress. Completing every row marks the Step 5 checklist item.

passport.title: Valid passport
passport.why: The application identifies the worker by passport. An expired or mismatched passport stalls filing.

how.valid: Confirm the passport is valid for the planned stay and matches the worker’s legal name.
how.copy: Keep a clear color scan of the biodata page (and visas/stamps if MUP asks).
how.mup: Re-check MUP temporary-stay document expectations for passport pages.

passport.evidence: Passport scan + note of expiry date.

criminal.title: Criminal-record / police certificate
criminal.why: MUP typically asks for criminal-record evidence from relevant countries of residence. The process is nationality-specific.

how.countries: List every country where the worker lived long enough that a certificate may be required.
how.nationality: Open the nationality panel on this step and follow that country’s official process (for U.S. workers: FBI Identity History Summary).
how.mup: Confirm on MUP pages whether apostille/legalization and translation are required for the certificate you obtained.

criminal.evidence: Ordered or received criminal-record document(s) with tracking notes.
criminal.caseHint: Do not invent a generic “police letter.” Use the official channel for the worker’s nationality.

insurance.title: Health insurance evidence
insurance.why: Stay applications usually require proof the worker is insured for the period of stay until public coverage is arranged.

how.policy: Collect a policy or certificate that covers Croatia for the planned arrival/filing window.
how.mup: Confirm acceptable insurance wording on the MUP temporary-stay page.
how.laterHzzo: Remember public health insurance registration (HZZO) comes after work is authorized — this step is about evidence for the application file.

insurance.evidence: Insurance certificate/policy PDF with coverage dates.

housing.title: Accommodation proof
housing.why: MUP expects proof of where the worker will stay. This must match the housing path you prepared in the employer package step.

how.proof: Collect a lease, hotel booking, or employer housing confirmation that matches the planned address.
how.employerStep: Reuse the housing evidence path from Step 3 (employer-provided vs worker-arranged).
how.mup: Confirm accommodation document expectations on MUP temporary-stay pages.

housing.evidence: Lease / booking / employer housing letter aligned with the application address.
housing.caseHint: Keep the same address story on housing proof, registration, and the permit forms.

photos.title: Application / biometric-style photos
photos.why: Filings and biometric cards need photos that meet official specifications.

how.specs: Ask the photo studio for Croatian residence/biometric application photos.
how.mup: Follow size and background rules on the live MUP instructions — do not guess millimetres from memory.
how.noInvent: This runbook does not invent photo dimensions; use the official MUP spec the day you shoot.

photos.evidence: Printed/digital photos meeting the current MUP specification.

translations.title: Apostille / legalization and Croatian translation plan
translations.why: Foreign public documents usually need formal authentication and a certified Croatian translation before MUP will accept them.

how.list: List every foreign public document in the file (criminal record, civil status if requested, etc.).
how.apostille: Arrange apostille or legalization as required for that issuing country.
how.sworn: Book a court-sworn Croatian translator early — this often sits on the critical path.

translations.evidence: Tracker: document → apostille/legalization status → translator booking.
translations.caseHint: Start the criminal-record → apostille → translation chain before the labor market test clock gets short.

timing.title: Align document timing with the labor market test window
timing.why: A positive labor market opinion is time-limited. Slow worker documents can burn the filing window.

how.order: Preferred order: order long-lead items (criminal record) first, then apostille/translation, then travel/appointments.
how.lmtWindow: After a positive HZZ notice, calendar the stay-and-work filing inside the cited validity window.
how.hzz: Re-read HZZ guidance on the positive-notice window while the worker file is still in motion.

timing.evidence: Shared timeline with owners for FBI/apostille/translation and the HZZ notice deadline.

fpGuide.panelIntro: Work through each row before you travel to the police desk. Completing every row marks Step 6 done. Fee amounts are cited from MUP; pay when MUP instructs (often on approval / at card collection). Biometrics attendance is Step 7.

lmtPrecondition.title: Labor market precondition still valid
lmtPrecondition.why: You may file only with a positive HZZ notice still inside its validity window, or with a documented official exemption (for example a confirmed UV skip).

how.notice: Keep the positive HZZ labor market test notice (or exemption proof) with the file.
how.window: Confirm the filing window on HZZ novi sustav (cited fact).
how.uv: If you claimed a UV skip, confirm the live UV list still covers the chosen title — do not invent an exemption.

lmtPrecondition.evidence: Positive HZZ notice dated within the cited window, or written UV/exemption proof tied to this occupation.

assemble.title: Full application file assembled
assemble.why: Incomplete files are rejected or delayed. Employer package, worker documents, and LMT/exemption proof must travel together.

how.employer: Include the employer package from Step 3 (contract/offer, Form 17a path, housing, tax standing).
how.worker: Include worker documents from Step 5 (passport, criminal record path, insurance/housing/photos as required).
how.lmt: Include LMT notice or exemption proof from Step 4.

assemble.evidence: Single folder (paper or PDF) with employer + worker + LMT/exemption set ready to hand in.

competence.title: Confirm Zagreb competent desk
competence.why: MUP routes applications by intended place of stay, employer seat, or place of work. Wrong desk wastes the visit.

how.rule: Re-read MUP temporary-stay competence wording (stay / employer seat / place of work).
how.zagreb: For this Zagreb-seat employer case, plan on Policijska uprava zagrebačka (PU Zagreb).
how.confirm: Confirm the exact receiving counter on live MUP / PU Zagreb channels before you travel — do not rely on outdated maps.

competence.evidence: Note of the confirmed desk name/address and the date you verified it.
competence.caseHint: This runbook assumes a Zagreb workplace/seat for the active case; other cities are not mapped yet.

form2a.title: Download current Form 2a (Obrazac 2a)
form2a.why: The official application for a stay-and-work permit is Form 2a. Templates change — always pull the live form.

how.download: Download Zahtjev za dozvolu za boravak i rad — Obrazac 2a (current edition).
how.noInvent: Do not invent form fields from blogs or older PDFs — use only the live official template.

form2a.evidence: Current blank Form 2a PDF with retrieval date noted (draft fill optional).
form2a.caseHint: Form 17a is a different employer form (Step 3). Filing uses Form 2a.

appointment.title: Confirm how to book or walk in
appointment.why: Zagreb desks may require an appointment or accept walk-ins. Rules change; ask the competent office.

how.askPu: Ask PU Zagrebačka (phone/counter instructions on official channels) how to book or whether walk-in is allowed for stay-and-work filing.
how.noInvent: Do not invent a national e-booking URL — none is cited here as Tier 1 for the LMT filing path.
how.notEmail: Do not use radna.dozvola.zagreb@mup.hr for a first LMT-required filing — that e-mail channel is for non-LMT / extensions / Art. 110 cases only.

appointment.evidence: Written note of booking reference or walk-in instructions and the date confirmed.

whoAppears.title: Who must appear
whoAppears.why: MUP treats the stay-and-work filing as the third-country national’s application. The employer supplies supporting documents.

how.worker: The worker (applicant) appears with a valid travel document and the completed Form 2a.
how.employerDocs: Bring the full employer-side attachments; an employer representative may accompany but is not invented here as a mandatory co-signer at the counter.
how.nationality: If the nationality panel says a consular channel applies instead, follow that panel — this guided path assumes in-country police filing.

whoAppears.evidence: Plan of who attends + packed file matching Form 2a attachments.

fees.title: Know the fee schedule (pay when instructed)
fees.why: MUP cites separate amounts for the stay-and-work administrative fee and biometric card production. Amounts are paid when MUP instructs — typically when you are notified of approval / at collection — not necessarily before you submit.

how.schedule: Re-open the MUP Work of third-country nationals fee section on payment day.
how.whenDue: Budget for the stay-and-work administrative fee when notified of approval; keep payment slips separate as MUP requires.
how.biometricsStep: Biometric production/admin fees are listed here for planning; attending biometrics and collecting the card is Step 7.

fees.evidence: Screenshot or printout of the live MUP fee wording dated today, plus a payment plan.

submit.title: Submit at the confirmed desk
submit.why: The application is not filed until the competent office receives it.

how.counter: Attend the confirmed Zagreb desk (or completed booking) with the full file.
how.complete: Hand in Form 2a + attachments; follow any on-site instructions for slips or missing items.

submit.evidence: Submission receipt, stamp, or written confirmation from the desk.

proof.title: Keep submission proof and a file copy
proof.why: You need proof of filing while waiting for the decision window and for biometrics later.

how.receipt: Retain the submission receipt / protocol number.
how.copy: Keep a complete copy of everything submitted (scans).

proof.evidence: Receipt + dated archive copy of the full filing set.

gates.art99Checklist: Mark the Art. 99 self-check checklist item
gates.occupationPathDecided: Decide {lmt} path or mark a {uv} skip candidate
gates.lmtGuided: Complete the labor market test guided checks

swGuide.panelIntro: Work top to bottom after the stay-and-work file is submitted. Completing every row marks Step 7 done. Fee amounts match Step 6 cites — pay when MUP instructs.

decision.title: Wait for a positive decision
decision.why: Authorization to work comes from MUP’s decision on the stay-and-work application, not from filing alone.

how.wait: Monitor the application / keep contact details current with the competent police desk.
how.timeline: Plan against the cited decision window; confirm operative wording on the statute / MUP page.
how.noWork: Do not schedule productive paid work in Croatia until the decision is positive.

decision.evidence: Written or portal confirmation of a positive stay-and-work decision (or clear refusal path if negative).

fees.title: Pay fees when MUP instructs
fees.why: Stay-and-work and biometric fees are typically due when you are notified of approval / at card production — not necessarily at filing.

how.mup: Re-open the MUP Work of third-country nationals fee section on payment day.
how.when: Pay the stay-and-work administrative fee and biometric amounts when instructed.
how.slips: Keep separate payment slips as MUP requires.

fees.evidence: Payment confirmations / slips for each cited fee paid.

biometrics.title: Attend biometrics when invited
biometrics.why: A biometric residence/work card is issued after approval; the worker must appear when called.

how.invite: Follow the invitation from the competent police administration / MUP instructions.
how.zagreb: For this Zagreb case, confirm the biometrics desk with PU Zagrebačka.
how.docs: Bring the travel document and any papers listed on the invitation.

biometrics.evidence: Biometrics appointment completed (stamp, confirmation, or desk note).
biometrics.caseHint: Card fee amounts are cited in the fees row above; attendance is this row.

card.title: Collect the residence/work card
card.why: The physical card is the day-to-day proof of authorized stay and work.

how.collect: Collect the card when notified it is ready.
how.scan: Scan both sides and store with the decision.

card.evidence: Scans of the issued card + decision in the case file.

address.title: Register temporary residence address
address.why: A third-country national on temporary stay must register boravište (and later address changes) with the competent police administration. The cited deadline runs from entry into Croatia or from the change. This is not the same clock as short-stay hotel/eVisitor self-registration.

how.mup: Read the MUP procedure for registering or changing a foreigner’s address (Form 16a).
how.desk: Register at the competent Zagreb police desk for the actual address, with Form 16a and housing proof.
how.verify: Put the cited deadline ({deadline}) on a shared calendar from entry or from a change of address, then re-check the live MUP procedure page before treating the date as final.

address.evidence: Registration confirmation / stamp for the worker’s temporary address (Form 16a).
address.caseHint: Do not mix this post-permit boravište clock with short-stay self-registration in the nationality panel. Permanent/long-term stay uses a different MUP deadline and is not this path.

hzmo.title: Register employment with HZMO (pension)
hzmo.why: Employers must register workers for pension insurance like any other employee.

how.site: Use official HZMO channels for employer registrations.
how.employer: File the employment registration as for a domestic hire.
how.align: Align the registration effective date with authorized work start.

hzmo.evidence: HZMO registration confirmation / printout in the file.

hzzo.title: Register health insurance with HZZO
hzzo.why: Public health insurance registration follows authorized employment.

how.site: Use official HZZO channels for employer registration.
how.employer: Complete health-insurance registration for the worker.

hzzo.evidence: HZZO registration confirmation in the file.

tax.title: Set up tax withholding (Porezna)
tax.why: Payroll must withhold and report tax correctly from the authorized start date.

how.porezna: Use Tax Administration / ePorezna employer tools as applicable.
how.withholding: Configure withholding and start date to match authorized work.

tax.evidence: Payroll/tax setup confirmation or first compliant payslip plan.

start.title: First working day only when authorized
start.why: Working before authorization risks misdemeanour sanctions for employer and worker.

how.date: Set the first productive working day on or after the authorized start.
how.payroll: Match the HR/payroll start date to that authorization.
how.noVisaFree: Do not treat visa-free presence as work permission.

start.evidence: HR note of authorized start date + first timesheet/payslip on or after that date.

cyGuide.panelIntro: Keep these rows current for the life of the permit. Completing every row marks Step 8 done. Re-open NN 55/2026 and MUP before acting on any window.

dates.title: Log permit and card expiry dates
dates.why: Missed renewals create unlawful stay/work risk.

how.card: Copy expiry dates from the decision and the biometric card.
how.calendar: Put renewals on a shared employer calendar with lead time.
how.owners: Assign an owner (HR / agency) for each reminder.

dates.evidence: Calendar entries + file note with card/decision expiry dates.

employerChange.title: Know employer-change rules before using them
employerChange.why: NN 55/2026 changed when a worker may change employer; mechanics still need live MUP confirmation.

how.nn: Read the employer-change framing in NN 55/2026 (cited period below).
how.mup: Confirm notification/approval steps on current MUP work-of-TCN guidance before any change.
how.verify: Do not move the worker to a new employer until the live process is followed.

employerChange.evidence: Internal note of the cited waiting period + link/date of the MUP page you verified.

unemployment.title: Know unemployment windows
unemployment.why: Job loss does not automatically end stay immediately, but windows are limited and must be verified.

how.nn: Note the standard and longer unemployment windows and the longer-hold qualifier (cited facts).
how.notify: If employment ends, follow employer notification duties to the police administration on live MUP rules.
how.verify: Re-open NN/MUP before relying on a window for a real termination.

unemployment.evidence: Playbook note with cited windows + owner who verifies before use.

a1.title: Plan A1.1 Croatian (Latin script) for extension
a1.why: Extension rules can require A1.1 proof after a cited stay period; some articles are deferred.

how.nn: Read the A1.1 + Latin script obligation context in NN 55/2026.
how.deferred: Treat the deferred force date as the planning milestone for the deferred articles.
how.schedule: Start language learning early so the worker is ready when the rule applies to extensions.

a1.evidence: Language plan with target level A1.1 Latin script + deferred-force date on the calendar.

renewal.title: Set renewal reminders before expiry
renewal.why: Starting renewal only after expiry risks a gap in lawful stay/work.

how.remind: Set reminders well before card/permit expiry.
how.mup: Follow current MUP renewal / extension channels when the time comes.
how.continuous: Keep employment continuous where the pathway requires it.

renewal.evidence: Renewal reminder dates + owner in the shared calendar.

longTerm.title: Know long-term residence is a later path
longTerm.why: Long-term / permanent stay is separate from the first Single Permit cycle.

how.mup: Skim the MUP long-term / permanent stay page (fee cite below is for awareness only).
how.later: Do not treat long-term residence as part of the first-year hiring checklist.

longTerm.evidence: Short note that long-term stay was reviewed as out-of-scope for year one.

overview.title: Where this case sits
overview.lead: Glance the hiring path: which stage is open, which child tasks still block the next stage, and which loop-backs apply if a filing fails. The map is read-only — changes happen on the checklist.
overview.notStarted: Not started — begin at occupation check
overview.branchLead: Either run the HZZ {lmt}, or skip it only when Article 99 / {uv} conditions truly fit.
overview.joinLabel: Both paths join again at MUP stay-and-work filing

graph.hint: Expand a stage to see the parallel child tasks that must clear before the next stage. Drag to pan · scroll to zoom. This map does not change the case.
graph.gateBlocked: These child tasks are still open, so the next stage stays locked.
graph.loopHint: A planning loop — not an extra legal track. Work the linked step if this issue actually happens.
graph.openStep: Open this step in the checklist
graph.stepLockedHint: Finish earlier steps in the checklist before you can work here.
graph.inspectorEmpty: Select a stage, child task, or loop. Child tasks are the real work; the stage cannot finish until they are cleared on the checklist.
graph.readOnlyChecks: Shown as-is from the case. Tick items on the step page.

summaries.decision: After the employer package, either run the HZZ labor market test or skip it only when the occupation truly matches the official deficitary list.
summaries.branchUv: Skip the labor market test only for a listed deficitary title with matching duties and employer conditions.
summaries.join: Both branches meet again before worker documents and the stay-and-work filing.

notes.orient: Confirm the Single Permit path and employer fitness. Wrong routes (Blue Card, seasonal shortcuts) are called out on the step.
notes.occupation: Lock a defensible title and choose the labor-market-test vs skip branch here. The map only displays that choice.
notes.package: Contract, pay, housing, and tax readiness before HZZ or MUP filing.
notes.decision: Chosen on the occupation step. This node does not store a separate decision.
notes.branchLmt: Default path: file the labor market test at HZZ, then use the positive-notice window.
notes.branchUv: Do not treat this branch as a shortcut. Confirm the live official list on the occupation step.
notes.join: The stay-and-work filing is the same desk either way. The labor market test step is a pass-through when the skip branch is active.
notes.workerDocs: Worker file plus nationality-specific items (for example U.S. FBI checks) on the step page.
notes.filePermit: File at the competent Zagreb police / MUP desk. Fees and forms live on the step with citations.
notes.startWork: Decision, biometrics, address registration, and social/tax filings before authorized start.
notes.comply: Keep dates, mobility windows, and language-plan items on a calendar after the hire starts.

lmtNegative.title: If HZZ refuses the test
lmtNegative.note: A negative labor-market notice means revise the occupation title/duties or reassess a genuine deficitary-list skip, then refile. Do not ignore the grounds on the notice.

lmtWindow.title: If the filing window lapses
lmtWindow.note: A positive notice is time-limited. If the cited stay-and-work filing window lapses, the labor market test work is repeated before filing.

permitNegative.title: If the permit is refused
permitNegative.note: A negative stay-and-work decision sends you back to the filing package and the stated grounds. This map does not invent a separate appeal track.

uncertainty.overviewIntro: Tier-1 pages disagree on some fees. Both readings are shown with sources and verification dates; the runbook adopts one value for this path.

stayWorkFee.title: Stay-and-work admin fee (Form 2a)
stayWorkFee.summary: MUP publishes two euro amounts that look similar but apply to different temporary-stay purposes.
stayWorkFee.spectrum: Unresolved if you mix pages; resolved for this hire by using the stay-and-work work page.
stayWorkFee.meaning74: Administrative fee for stay and work / Form 2a on the Work of TCN page.
stayWorkFee.meaning46: Fee listed for other temporary-stay purposes — not the stay-and-work path used here.
stayWorkFee.pageNoteWork: Live MUP Work of TCN page (fees section).
stayWorkFee.pageNoteTemp: Live MUP temporary-stay fees page — other purposes.

biometricFee.title: Biometric card issuance fee
biometricFee.summary: Same MUP page lists regular and accelerated production fees. They are options, not a contradiction of the base fee.
biometricFee.spectrum: Resolved for the checklist by adopting the regular fee unless acceleration is chosen.
biometricFee.meaningRegular: Regular biometric residence permit production fee.
biometricFee.meaningAccelerated: Accelerated production option — higher fee, not the default checklist amount.
biometricFee.pageNote: Live MUP Work of TCN page (biometric / production fees).
